description: Suraj Cotton Mills Limited is a Lahore-based textile manufacturer that has produced yarn and woven fabric since 1984. It operates three spinning units — at Nooriabad in Sindh and Shahkot and Raiwind in Punjab — with 125,000 ring spindles, and an air-jet weaving unit of 358 looms producing about 3.6 million metres of greige fabric a month. It describes itself as specialising in fine-count yarns and greige fabrics of up to 700 thread count for sheeting, apparel, suiting and home furnishings.
